title: Backtick command inside fenced code block executes at skill-load time
body: The SKILL.md parser executes `!`...`` patterns even when they appear inside fenced code blocks (this is a known parser bug, GitHub #12781, and is documented in this repo's own skill-development rules as something to never do). Line 11 writes `!`git status`` intending to show an example bash invocation, but instead of being inert documentation it will actually be executed as a live command the moment this skill is loaded — a real behavior regression from the intended 'this is just an example' contract of a fenced code block. Escaping with a backslash does not fix it either. Replace it with the repo's documented-safe notation, e.g. `$ git status`, so the block stays inert.
